title: Construct String with Minimum Cost
summary: Given a target string and an array of words along with their associated costs, construct the target string by appending words to an empty string s.
statement: Given a target string and an array of words along with their associated costs, construct the target string by appending words to an empty string s. The cost of appending each word is as specified in the costs array. Return the minimum total cost required to form the target string, or -1 if it is impossible to form the target string.
constraints: target is nonempty; words and positive costs have equal nonzero length, and words are nonempty.
Starting empty, append whole listed words to form target exactly; a word may be reused.
Return the minimum total cost or -1 when construction is impossible.
target_time_complexity: O(total word length+target length*maximum word length)
hints: Target construction is a shortest path over prefix positions; trie traversal lists all word edges beginning at one position.
Store the minimum cost for duplicate words, then relax reachable target prefixes through trie matches.
For each reachable start, walk target characters in trie; at each word end relax dp[end+1].
Every construction uniquely partitions target into trie words, and DP considers its edges in increasing prefix order, yielding the minimum path cost.
editorial: Every construction uniquely partitions target into trie words, and DP considers its edges in increasing prefix order, yielding the minimum path cost.
